name: Skills
description: Commercial vs federal skill demand by composition. Mirrors Phase 3 #2.

cards.text:
## Skills
**Sources:** `v_skill_category_composition` (primary) and `v_skill_top_by_source` (drill-down), skill tags at confidence >= 0.8.

**Mirrors:** Phase 3 #2 (docs/findings_commercial_vs_federal_skills.md). Commercial (Adzuna) text is truncated at about 500 characters, so a skill's absence there is not evidence the role doesn't require it. Data window: see the right.

cards.title: Data window
cards.description: First and last UTC snapshot date and the jobs per market behind the shares. Commercial (Adzuna) text is truncated at about 500 characters, so a skill's absence there is not evidence the role doesn't require it.

cards.title: Skill-tag share by category, per market
cards.description: Share of skill tags per taxonomy category within each market, with n_tags and the market's job count: composition, not magnitude. Commercial (Adzuna) text is truncated at about 500 characters, so a skill's absence there is not evidence the role doesn't require it.

cards.title: Top commercial skills
cards.description: Rate with its count (n_jobs_tagged) and the market's job count. The Phase 3 write-up applies n >= 15 for commercial. Commercial (Adzuna) text is truncated at about 500 characters, so a skill's absence there is not evidence the role doesn't require it.

cards.title: Top federal skills
cards.description: Rate with its count (n_jobs_tagged) and the market's job count; the federal population is small, and the Phase 3 write-up applies n >= 5. Federal text is full-length. Commercial (Adzuna) text is truncated at about 500 characters, so a skill's absence there is not evidence the role doesn't require it.
